description: Collection, Processing, Disposal, and Recycling of Waste Materials is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Commerce and Industry. This dataset contains information about the collection, processing, disposal, and recycling of waste materials in Qatar. It includes the number of firms, investments in millions of Qatari Riyals, and labor statistics. The dataset focuses on both industrial registration and industrial licenses in this sector, showing trends in business activity and labor force over time. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Its tags are investment, labor force, waste, recycling, disposal. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
